title: Sonarr does not recognize multi audio English / French
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

When a file is dual audio with French and English, Sonarr does not recognize both languages.

### Expected Behavior

Sonarr recognizes both languages, allowing to use custom formats to prefer dual language

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Use the test parsing button at "/settings/customformats"
2. Try with any show and episode number
3. Put "FR", it recognizes French, put "ENG", it recognizes English, put "FR ENG", it only recognizes French

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: AlmaLinux 9
- Sonarr: 4.0.15.2941
- Docker Install: Yes
- Using Reverse Proxy: Yes
- Browser: Firefox 141
- Database: Sqlite 3.49.2
```

### What branch are you running?

Main

### Trace Logs?

Does this issue really need trace logs?

### Anything else?

_No response_
author: diamkil

comments.author: thezoggy
comments.body: sonarr wouldnt know what the audio languages is used until it can actually probe the media. it only has the release name/file name to originally go off of. which means a supported naming scheme has to be used to be parsed for it to understand. you would need to provide examples of what is not working as well as logs...
